Assam Schedule VIII, Form No. 127 
High Court Criminal Form No. (M) 106 
ORDER SHEET 
IN THE COURT OF CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE, SEPPA, EAST KAMENG DISTRICT, 
ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Cr. Miscellaneous application No. 36/2025 
Under Section 146 BNSS, 2023 
In 
 CR/ Maint. Case No. 12/2020 
Shri Moye Singhi -vs- Smti. Meje Mangkhya 
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
23.10.2025 
 
This Criminal Miscellaneous application being registered 
as Cr. Misc. No. 36/2025 is filed under section 146 BNSS, 
2023 by the applicant Shri Moye Singhi praying for the 
alteration of maintenance order dated 24.03.2021 in 
CR/Maintenance Case No. 12/2020. 
The applicant is represented by his learned counsel Mr. 
Arjun Rigam. 
I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner who 
submitted that the petitioner Shri Moye Singhi was married to 
respondent Smti. Meje Mangkhya and due to some issues 
between them they got separated and accordingly, vide order 
dated 24.03.2021, this court has passed a maintenance order 
by granting Rs. 6,000/- per month in favour of the 
respondent namely Meje Mangkhya. According to the learned 
counsel for the petitioner, now the respondent Smti. Meje 
Mangkhya had remarried to Shri Pitam Loda of Mebuwa 
village which has been duly certified by the GBs of the said 
village(Annexure II(a)) of the petition. Hence, the petitioner 
has prayed for alteration or modification of the maintenance 
order 
dated 
24.03.2021 
by 
way of 
cancellation 
of 
maintenance order by provisions of Section 146(3)(a) of

Page | 2  
 
BNSS, 2023.  
After hearing the learned counsel for the petitioner, the 
case is admitted for hearing. 
Issue notice to the respondent.  
The petitioner shall take steps, dasti service is also 
allowed 
List the case on 03.12.2025 for appearance of the 
respondent. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
CJM, Seppa
